Messages.Author: hawk_the_demon
Messages.Body:
well, from the card texts:

Legion:
'...This vampire can put a Master: Discipline cards from your hand or
ash heap in play to represent a fledgeling...'

Ethan:
'... Ethan may steal a Master Discipline card from another vampire...'

the M:D cards represents a vampire, it's not 'on' a vampire so it can't
be stolen 'from' a vampire (it's how I'd rule it, but I've been wrong
from time to time).
and SI is not a M:D card.

conclusion: Ethan can't steal either the M:D from the fledgeling or a
SI.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
> what happens if Ethan steals a master: discipline card that is a
> vampire, via Legion or Shock Troops?

Legion: doesn't exist yet.
Shock Troops: "do not count as Master: Discipline cards while in play."

> does the vampire just 'dissipate'?
> or can Ethan not do it, as the skill card doesn't count as a master:
> discipline card while in play as a vampire?

A vampire cannot use a "steal equipment" effect to steal a card that
doesn't count as equipment while in play.

A vampire cannot use a "steal Master: Discipline" effect to steal a card
that doesn't count as a Master: Discipline while in play.
